newsitem.title: GERMANY: TABLE-Hypo-Bank H1 oper profit up 17.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Hypo-Bank H1 oper profit up 17.2 pct.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit after provisions 651.7 up 17.2 pct
Group net interest income 2,184 down 3.1 pct
Group net commission income 705.0 up 58.1 pct
Group balance sheet total 357,200 up 5.2 pct

NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG, which last week announced plans to merge with Bayerische Vereinsbank AG to become Europe's second largest commercial bank.
Analysts polled by Reuters had on average predicted an operating profit of 686.5 million marks, up 23.5 percent.
The bank said the rise in its commission income was due to its majority takeover of Foreign and Colonial, without which commission income would have risen by 35.3 percent.
Without the consolidation of Foreign and Colonial, administrative costs would have risen only 0.2 percent.
The balance sheet total is compared with end-1996.
